build_resnet14_sparse: build a ResNet14 sparse convolutional network using BasicBlock with 1 layer per stage for 3D point cloud features
build_resnet50_sparse: build a ResNet50 sparse convolutional network using Bottleneck blocks with 3-4-6-3 layers per stage for 3D features
build_stresnet50_spatiotemporal: build a STResNet50 spatiotemporal network using spatial hypercube temporal hypercross convolutions for 4D data
build_strestesseractnet50: build a STResTesseractNet50 network using full hypercube convolutions for 4D spatiotemporal sparse tensor processing
review_resnetbase_make_layer: review the ResNetBase _make_layer method to understand how downsample and block layers are constructed with dilation
